'''MaryGail Coffee''' was a Florida Decipher event organizer who, with [[Chris Coffee]], ran the Decipher events at a Kissimmee, Florida gaming convention on 22–24 March 2002, including the first Star Wars CCG Open sanctioned by the [[Players Committee]].<ref name="rfd119a">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8KvLjZofZcY Broadcast 119 - Radio Free Decipher (15 March, 2002): Chris and MaryGail Coffee on SWCCG Open], Player's Council, YouTube (originally released 15 March 2002). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-8KvLjZofZcY Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 119 transcript]], 09:20–10:45.</ref> The two described the events on [[Radio Free Decipher]] Broadcast 119 (15 March 2002).

== Events ==
At the Kissimmee convention she ran Smackdown 2002, a ''Lord of the Rings'' tournament on Sunday 24 March meant to be Florida's first large tournament for that game, and a ''Mines of Moria'' sealed event on the Friday. The convention also asked for an ''Austin Powers'' demo tournament.<ref name="rfd119b">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8KvLjZofZcY Broadcast 119 - Radio Free Decipher (15 March, 2002): Chris and MaryGail Coffee on SWCCG Open], Player's Council, YouTube (originally released 15 March 2002). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-8KvLjZofZcY Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 119 transcript]], 11:55–15:55.</ref> She also described an earlier large sealed-deck demo at Channelside in Tampa that drew 42 players.<ref name="rfd119c">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8KvLjZofZcY Broadcast 119 - Radio Free Decipher (15 March, 2002): Chris and MaryGail Coffee on SWCCG Open], Player's Council, YouTube (originally released 15 March 2002). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-8KvLjZofZcY Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 119 transcript]], 15:05.</ref>
